scope: Human cross-sectional snRNA-seq; author-retained nuclei and broad cell labels; donor is statistical unit; no treatment effect or independent mechanistic validation
normalization: log2(1+1e6*target_sum/all_gene_UMI_sum) per donor and broad cell type; no cell pooling across donors
test: Two-sided exact permutation of 3 versus 3 donors: 20 allocations. BH across two primary comparisons only. Other gene/cell-type combinations descriptive. Minimum attainable two-sided p=0.1. LOO excludes one donor per group (nine contrasts).
interpretation_rule: Describe support for both specified compartments only if both disease-minus-normal effects positive and all nine LOO effects positive. This is descriptive direction stability, not significance, efficacy, receptor engagement, or causal signaling. No threshold retuning.
missing: Any donor stratum below 20 nuclei excluded from inferential contrast; report missing, do not impute. Exact three-v-three comparison requires all six donors.
annotation: Use author CellType_healthy for Normal and CellType_injured for Disease; no relabeling or new cell QC; raw counts include ambient RNA; no full reproduction of Seurat normalization
limits: Three diseased donors have F4, Brunt2/4, F3 rather than one homogeneous stage.
AM031 annotation age61-70 vs workbook51-60; AM072 annotation51-60 vs workbook61-70. Unresolved, no age covariate.
Paper already discussed SEMA4D–PLXNB2 in healthy zonal signaling; not a blinded pathway holdout.
Disease group not alcohol-specific; no longitudinal or drug-treated data.
Subject overlap with prior studies not exhaustively excluded.
